hadith:
Dress - Narrated Thabit:

Anas was asked whether the Prophet (ﷺ) used a a hair dye or not. He replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) did not have enough grey hair to dye, (such that) if I wanted to count the fading hairs in his beard (I could have)."
message: Those who truly believe and perform good deeds are the most honored among all creation, a status that comes not from outward appearance but from the sincerity of the heart and righteous actions. Allah, Al-Musawwir—The Shaper of Beauty—has crafted each of us with deliberate purpose and design, reminding us that true beauty lies in our character and faith rather than in our physical features. Let this inspire you to focus on cultivating inner excellence through belief and righteous deeds, for that is what elevates the soul in the sight of Allah.
name:
Al Musawwir - الْمُصَوِّرُ - The Shaper of Beauty

Al Musawwir is one of the names of Allah in Islam, highlighting His role in shaping and defining the forms of all beings. The name emphasizes the intricate design and beauty of creation, illustrating that all forms and features in the universe are crafted by the Creator. The understanding of this name encourages believers to recognize the deliberate and purposeful creation of the world around them.
verse:
Al-Bayyinah - The Clear Proof - 98:7

Indeed, those who believe and do good—they are the best of ˹all˺ beings.
